checks.explanation: Emmer laid out an aggressive timeline aiming to get the reconciliation bill to Trump's desk by Memorial Day weekend 2025 (~May 26). In reality, the House passed its version May 22, but after Senate amendments and further negotiation, the final 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act' wasn't signed into law until July 4, 2025 -- about six weeks later than predicted.

sources.title: President Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill Is Now the Law - The White House

checks.explanation: Emmer predicted all of Trump's cabinet nominees, including Pete Hegseth (Defense), Tulsi Gabbard (DNI), and RFK Jr. (HHS), would be confirmed despite Democratic opposition. All three were confirmed by the Senate in early-to-mid 2025, as were the rest of the cabinet.
